items.html: And the matter is as was said of Arich Anpin: after his entire Partzuf was corrected, his head was corrected more, in fullness, in the secret of the seven Tikunim of the skull, in which the ZAT of Atik were clothed and shone. So too in ZA, after the correction, the seven Tikunim of the skull need to be corrected, from the aspect of Atik. And it is known that Atik does not spread except in the clothing of Arich Anpin; so the seven Tikunim of the skull of Arich Anpin, in which are concealed the ZAT of Atik, will shine within the seven of the skull of ZA, and the seven of the skull in ZA will be completed as well.
